propositions: A new `commit_and_push_tickets_branch` entrypoint must stage and commit dirty tracker changes under an acquired write lock before delegating to the existing push-only `push_tickets_branch` primitive.

The entrypoint must guard against rebase/merge-recovery state before staging: strict mode raises `PushDeliveryError` with `merge-recovery-blocked` reason; default mode warns and returns without committing.
Supplied author name/email must be applied per-commit via `git -c user.name/email` without mutating global or repository config; ambient identity is used when omitted.
A clean but locally-ahead tracker must push without creating an empty commit; under strict mode, persistent rejection raises `PushDeliveryError` and preserves the local commit.

Default-mode lock, stage, and commit failures must warn and return without invoking push, retaining content for later clean retry; strict mode raises the dependency-defined `PushDeliveryError` with stable typed reasons.
The existing `push_tickets_branch` function and its CLI action must remain strictly push-only and must not stage or commit.
